If we don't stand behind a product, no commission is high enough to put it here.

recipient.title: Who is this gift for?
recipient.subtitle: Tell us who it's for first — it sets everything that comes after.
recipient.customLabel: Or tell me who they are
recipient.customPlaceholder: e.g. my boyfriend who just got promoted, my fishing-nut father-in-law, my best friend since childhood

age.title: How old are they?
age.subtitle: Age narrows the field — a 25-year-old and a 55-year-old are worlds apart.
age.customLabel: Or tell me their exact age
age.customPlaceholder: e.g. just turned 22, almost 40, 70 but still active

occasion.title: What's the occasion?
occasion.subtitle: Occasion changes what 'right' even means.
occasion.customPlaceholder: e.g. 3-year dating anniversary, dad's 60th, housewarming, a small surprise for her after a trip

budget.title: What's your budget?
budget.subtitle: A range is fine — we'll find the best within it.
budget.customPlaceholder: e.g. under $50, between $80–$150, whatever fits, I just want the right one

interests.title: What do they love?
interests.subtitle: Pick all that fit — the more you choose, the sharper it gets.
interests.customLabel: Or tell me what they love
interests.customPlaceholder: e.g. hand-pour coffee every morning, camps every weekend, learning oil painting, loves vintage cameras

personality.title: Their personality?
personality.subtitle: This decides practical versus romantic.
personality.customPlaceholder: e.g. quiet but remembers everything, values handmade gifts more than store-bought ones, loves weird little trinkets

giftStyle.title: What style of gift?
giftStyle.subtitle: A physical thing, an experience, or a surprise — you decide the direction.
giftStyle.customLabel: Or describe the vibe you want
giftStyle.customPlaceholder: e.g. something they'll use every day, something unexpected, an experience rather than a thing

closeness.title: How close are you?
closeness.subtitle: Last one — closeness sets the weight of the gift.
closeness.customPlaceholder: e.g. girlfriend of 5 years, former coworker who helped me a lot, a professor I barely know but need to thank
